name_reason: Compliant: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> form with domain=graphics (gfxtab.c/.object2 graphics constant). Descriptor 'radian_per_degree' accurately names the deg->rad multiplier; '_const' reflects the read-only scalar nature. No Ghidra address residue. Name correctly reflects both purpose and data type (a constant multiplier).
purpose: Degrees-to-radians multiplier (a 7-digit approximation of pi/180) for the AoE radial-scatter sprite geometry.
logic_summary: Read-only IEEE-754 double constant. Sole reader fd2_scatter_sprite_around_origin_with_random_offset (@0x21DFC) loads it via FMUL m64 and computes angle_rad = angle_deg * this_const, where angle_deg is a whole-degree value 0..359 (rng % 0x168). The resulting radian angle feeds cos/sin for polar->Cartesian scatter offsets.
element_semantics: Single scalar = 0.0174532. Stored bytes af 99 d7 6c 40 df 91 3f (LE) = IEEE-754 0x3F91DF406CD799AF. C literal 0.0174532 encodes byte-exact to these bytes (verified). This is a 7-digit truncated approximation of pi/180, NOT full-precision pi/180 (0.017453292519943295).
notes: Single reader, zero writers -> confirmed read-only const (is_const=true). Byte-encoding of 0.0174532 verified byte-exact against stored bytes via PowerShell BitConverter; confirmed != pi/180 full precision. src comment block (gfxtab.c lines 20-31) was already precise and correct -> comment_verdict=keep, no Edit made. Wrote a clean PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (startTransaction/endTransaction, cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...)) and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT; verified PLATE now set and PRE=null. ghidra_plate_action=created (PLATE field went from empty to populated). No src file change, so staged repo range is only this shard.
